summary: Founder-led 25-staff shop, 2-5 M EUR; our ~EUR 219k is ~4-11 % of its turnover. Won a large hydraulics contract and confirms extra volume only against binding 12-month commitments. Holds 70 % of pump shaft HN 24 mm at 24.92, already 1.2 % below its own plant should-cost; sup:70210 holds 30 % at 24.37 with free capacity. Open moderately, buy price with lead time and binding volume, use sup:70210 and the amber scorecard, do not squeeze hard.
notes: Needs binding volume and planning security; fears tying capacity to unplanned demand. Price below its full cost yet it gave 2.7-2.9 % reductions in 2023 and 2025. We pay 9.8 days late on average (79 % >5 days late) without written complaint. OTD 69-81 %, 1 open 8D.
